interface_notes.value: The δ ferrite bands are the only microstructural constituent with a clear orientation, making them the most likely reason for the lower ductility measured along TD.

phase_evolution.value: During annealing at 1000 °C, Cr7C3 carbides, intergranular κ-carbides and ferrite transform significantly to austenite, resulting in high Mn/Al/C concentrations in austenite for high-density nanosized κ-carbide precipitation during water quenching.
